answer: Map the economy like karst terrain: legitimate agents leave connected underground channels of transactions that auditors can trace, while sybil clusters are isolated sinkholes with no outlet to real work. Let zephyr audits drift in unpredictably, light random spot-checks that no farm can schedule around or rehearse for. Require every identity to hold at least one vertex in the trust graph verified independently by outsiders, so a closed loop of fake accounts endorsing each other has no anchor to the real network.
